dataset_type: Weighted Score Summary Matrix (All 40 Finalist Models)
single_metric_modifier_rule: Delta_sec in [-0.10, +0.20] for single-variable linear interpolation
composite_seat_pan_formula: S_SeatPan = ROUND_HALF_UP(S_thermal(dT) + C_contour + C_depth + C_rim, 1) where C_contour in [0.00, +0.60], C_depth in [-0.25, +0.50], C_rim in [-0.40, 0.00]
combined_desk_lift_quiet_formula: S_LiftQuiet = ROUND_HALF_UP(S_acoustic(dBA) + Delta_speed(v_lift), 1) where Delta_speed in [-0.10, +0.05] and Extended Acoustic Bracket A5 covers 53.1-55.5 dBA -> 7.9-8.2

Composite Seat Pan Formula: S_thermal(+2.2°F in [1.5, 3.5]°F -> [9.5, 9.8]) = 9.6950 + C_contour(0.00) + C_depth(-0.10 fixed 16.75" depth) + C_rim(-0.40 rigid glass-filled nylon outer rim thigh contact) = 9.1950 -> 9.2/10.

Composite Seat Pan Formula: S_thermal(+2.4°F in [1.5, 3.5]°F -> [9.5, 9.8]) = 9.6650 + C_contour(0.00) + C_depth(-0.25 fixed non-sliding seat depth) + C_rim(0.00 waterfall front edge) = 9.4150 -> 9.4/10.

Rigidity: 1.8 mm in [1.2, 2.0] mm -> Base 9.5000 + Delta_sec(+0.10 3-stage C-frame column overlap) = 9.6000 -> 9.6/10. Lift & Quietness: S_acoustic(44.5 dBA in [42.5, 45.0] dBA -> [9.4, 9.8]) = 9.4800 + Delta_speed(+0.05 for 1.50 in/s fast dual-motor lift) = 9.5300 -> 9.5/10.

Rigidity: 2.7 mm in [2.1, 3.0] mm -> Base 9.0333 + Delta_sec(0.00 standard 2-stage frame) = 9.0333 -> 9.0/10. Lift & Quietness: S_acoustic(47.8 dBA in [47.6, 50.0] dBA -> [8.6, 9.0]) = 8.9667 + Delta_speed(-0.05 for 1.20 in/s moderate lift speed) = 8.9167 -> 8.9/10.
